/*
    Dashboard Kỷ luật sinh viên — DASH_StudentSanction_GetData
    Nguồn: SIM_Sanction, SIM_Student, SIM_Class, SIM_Science, SIM_Course
            GEN_SanctionForm, GEN_ViolationType

    Lọc ngày theo SIM_Sanction.Signingdate (giống các dashboard khác)
    @ScienceID, @CourseID, @ClassID — tuỳ chọn
    @YearID, @Semester — bắt buộc
    @FromDate, @ToDate — tuỳ chọn; mặc định tháng hiện tại
    @ResultSet: 1..7 trả 1 result set; NULL trả đủ 7 result set

    Result set 1 — KPI
    Result set 2 — Phân bố hình thức kỷ luật (donut)
    Result set 3 — Quyết định KL theo tháng (bar / area)
    Result set 4 — Số quyết định KL theo khoa (horizontal bar)
    Result set 5 — QĐ còn HL / hết HL theo khóa (stacked)
    Result set 6 — Phân bố loại vi phạm (donut)
    Result set 7 — Top lớp có nhiều QĐ KL (vertical bar)
*/

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DASH_StudentSanction_GetData', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentSanction_GetData;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentSanction_GetData
(
    @ScienceID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @CourseID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @ClassID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @YearID int,
    @Semester tinyint,
    @FromDate datetime = NULL,
    @ToDate datetime = NULL,
    @ResultSet tinyint = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @FromDate IS NULL
        SET @FromDate = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0);

    IF @ToDate IS NULL
        SET @ToDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0)));

    -- Đảm bảo @ToDate bao gồm cả ngày cuối (đến 23:59:59)
    SET @ToDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate);
    SET @ToDate = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, @ToDate);

    Select
        SIM_Sanction.SanctionID,
        SIM_Sanction.StudentID,
        SIM_Student.StudentCode,
        SIM_Student.ClassID,
        SIM_Class.ClassName,
        SIM_Class.ClassShortName,
        SIM_Class.ScienceID,
        SIM_Science.ScienceName,
        SIM_Class.CourseID,
        SIM_Course.CourseName,
        SIM_Sanction.SanctionFormID,
        GEN_SanctionForm.SanctionFormName,
        SIM_Sanction.ViolationTypeID,
        GEN_ViolationType.ViolationTypeName,
        SIM_Sanction.Signingdate,
        SIM_Sanction.EffectiveDate,
        SIM_Sanction.ExpiredDate,
        SIM_Sanction.IsSuspended,
        SIM_Sanction.IsActived,
        SIM_Sanction.YearID,
        SIM_Sanction.Semester,
        Case
            when SIM_Sanction.ExpiredDate is null then 1
            when SIM_Sanction.ExpiredDate >= Cast(GetDate() as date) then 1
            else 0
        End as IsEffectiveNow
    Into #tblSanctionView
    From SIM_Sanction
        Inner Join SIM_Student On SIM_Student.StudentID = SIM_Sanction.StudentID
        Inner Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Inner Join SIM_Science On SIM_Science.ScienceID = SIM_Class.ScienceID
        Inner Join SIM_Course On SIM_Course.CourseID = SIM_Class.CourseID
        Inner Join GEN_SanctionForm On GEN_SanctionForm.SanctionFormID = SIM_Sanction.SanctionFormID
        Inner Join GEN_ViolationType On GEN_ViolationType.ViolationTypeID = SIM_Sanction.ViolationTypeID
    Where SIM_Sanction.IsActived = 1
        And SIM_Sanction.YearID = @YearID
        And SIM_Sanction.Semester = @Semester
        And SIM_Sanction.Signingdate >= @FromDate
        And SIM_Sanction.Signingdate <= @ToDate
        And SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
        And SIM_Class.IsActived = 1
        And SIM_Class.ClassType = 0
        And (@ClassID is null or @ClassID = N'' or CHARINDEX(',' + SIM_Student.ClassID + ',', ',' + @ClassID + ',') > 0)
        And (@ScienceID is null or @ScienceID = N'' or CHARINDEX(',' + SIM_Class.ScienceID + ',', ',' + @ScienceID + ',') > 0)
        And (@CourseID is null or @CourseID = N'' or CHARINDEX(',' + SIM_Class.CourseID + ',', ',' + @CourseID + ',') > 0);

    /* Result set 1 — KPI */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    BEGIN
        Select
            Count(*) as TotalSanction,
            Count(Distinct StudentID) as DistinctStudent,
            Sum(Case when IsEffectiveNow = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ActiveSanction,
            Sum(Case when IsSuspended = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as SuspendedCount
        From #tblSanctionView;
    END

    /* Result set 2 — Phân bố hình thức kỷ luật */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 2
    BEGIN
        Select
            SanctionFormID,
            SanctionFormName,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount
        From #tblSanctionView
        Group by SanctionFormID, SanctionFormName
        Order by SanctionCount desc, SanctionFormName;
    END

    /* Result set 3 — Quyết định KL theo tháng (Signingdate) */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 3
    BEGIN
        Select
            Month(Signingdate) as MonthNo,
            N'T' + Cast(Month(Signingdate) as nvarchar(2)) as MonthLabel,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount,
            Count(Distinct StudentID) as StudentCount
        From #tblSanctionView
        Where Signingdate is not null
        Group by Month(Signingdate)
        Order by MonthNo;
    END

    /* Result set 4 — Số quyết định KL theo khoa */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 4
    BEGIN
        Select
            ScienceID,
            ScienceName,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount,
            Count(Distinct StudentID) as StudentCount
        From #tblSanctionView
        Group by ScienceID, ScienceName
        Order by SanctionCount desc, ScienceName;
    END

    /* Result set 5 — QĐ còn HL / hết HL theo khóa */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 5
    BEGIN
        Select
            CourseID,
            CourseName,
            Sum(Case when IsEffectiveNow = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ActiveSanction,
            Sum(Case when IsEffectiveNow = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as ExpiredSanction
        From #tblSanctionView
        Group by CourseID, CourseName
        Order by CourseName;
    END

    /* Result set 6 — Phân bố loại vi phạm */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 6
    BEGIN
        Select
            ViolationTypeID,
            ViolationTypeName,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount
        From #tblSanctionView
        Group by ViolationTypeID, ViolationTypeName
        Order by SanctionCount desc, ViolationTypeName;
    END

    /* Result set 7 — Top lớp có nhiều QĐ KL */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 7
    BEGIN
        Select
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount,
            Count(Distinct StudentID) as StudentCount
        From #tblSanctionView
        Group by ClassID, ClassName
        Order by SanctionCount desc, ClassName;
    END
END
GO

/*
    Ví dụ test:
    Exec dbo.DASH_StudentSanction_GetData @YearID = 2025, @Semester = 1, @ResultSet = 1;
*/

/*
    Dashboard Khen thưởng sinh viên — DASH_StudentReward_GetData
    Nguồn: SIM_Reward, SIM_Student, SIM_Class, SIM_Science, SIM_Course, GEN_RewardForm

    Lọc ngày theo SIM_Reward.Signingdate (giống DASH_StudentSanction_GetData)
    @ScienceID, @CourseID, @ClassID — tuỳ chọn
    @YearID, @Semester — bắt buộc
    @FromDate, @ToDate — tuỳ chọn; mặc định tháng hiện tại
    @ResultSet: 1..7 trả 1 result set; NULL trả đủ 7 result set

    Result set 1 — KPI
    Result set 2 — Phân bố hình thức khen thưởng (donut)
    Result set 3 — Quyết định KT theo tháng (bar / area)
    Result set 4 — Số quyết định KT theo khoa (horizontal bar)
    Result set 5 — QĐ KT theo khóa / học kỳ (stacked HK1 / HK2)
    Result set 6 — Phân bố lý do khen thưởng (donut)
    Result set 7 — Top lớp có nhiều QĐ KT (vertical bar)

    Tên cột output giữ cùng alias với DASH_StudentSanction_GetData để API/JS tái sử dụng.
*/

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DASH_StudentReward_GetData', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentReward_GetData;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentReward_GetData
(
    @ScienceID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @CourseID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @ClassID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @YearID int,
    @Semester tinyint,
    @FromDate datetime = NULL,
    @ToDate datetime = NULL,
    @ResultSet tinyint = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @FromDate IS NULL
        SET @FromDate = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0);

    IF @ToDate IS NULL
        SET @ToDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0)));

    -- Đảm bảo @ToDate bao gồm cả ngày cuối (đến 23:59:59)
    SET @ToDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate);
    SET @ToDate = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, @ToDate);

    Select
        SIM_Reward.StudentID,
        SIM_Student.StudentCode,
        SIM_Student.ClassID,
        SIM_Class.ClassName,
        SIM_Class.ClassShortName,
        SIM_Class.ScienceID,
        SIM_Science.ScienceName,
        SIM_Class.CourseID,
        SIM_Course.CourseName,
        SIM_Reward.RewardFormID,
        IsNull(GEN_RewardForm.RewardFormName, N'Không xác định') as RewardFormName,
        SIM_Reward.DecisionNo,
        SIM_Reward.Signingdate,
        SIM_Reward.Signer,
        Case
            when IsNull(LTrim(RTrim(SIM_Reward.Reason)), N'') = N'' then N'Không ghi lý do'
            else LTrim(RTrim(SIM_Reward.Reason))
        End as ReasonName,
        SIM_Reward.YearID,
        SIM_Reward.Semester,
        SIM_Reward.Description
    Into #tblRewardView
    From SIM_Reward
        Inner Join SIM_Student On SIM_Student.StudentID = SIM_Reward.StudentID
        Inner Join SIM_Class On SIM_Class.ClassID = SIM_Student.ClassID
        Inner Join SIM_Science On SIM_Science.ScienceID = SIM_Class.ScienceID
        Inner Join SIM_Course On SIM_Course.CourseID = SIM_Class.CourseID
        Left Join GEN_RewardForm On GEN_RewardForm.RewardFormID = SIM_Reward.RewardFormID
    Where SIM_Reward.YearID = @YearID
        And SIM_Reward.Semester = @Semester
        And SIM_Reward.Signingdate >= @FromDate
        And SIM_Reward.Signingdate <= @ToDate
        And SIM_Student.IsDeleted = 0
        And SIM_Class.IsActived = 1
        And SIM_Class.ClassType = 0
        And (@ClassID is null or @ClassID = N'' or CHARINDEX(',' + SIM_Student.ClassID + ',', ',' + @ClassID + ',') > 0)
        And (@ScienceID is null or @ScienceID = N'' or CHARINDEX(',' + SIM_Class.ScienceID + ',', ',' + @ScienceID + ',') > 0)
        And (@CourseID is null or @CourseID = N'' or CHARINDEX(',' + SIM_Class.CourseID + ',', ',' + @CourseID + ',') > 0);

    /* Result set 1 — KPI */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    BEGIN
        Select
            Count(*) as TotalSanction,
            Count(Distinct StudentID) as DistinctStudent,
            Count(Distinct RewardFormID) as ActiveSanction,
            (
                Select Count(*)
                From (
                    Select StudentID
                    From #tblRewardView
                    Group by StudentID
                    Having Count(*) >= 2
                ) tblMulti
            ) as SuspendedCount
        From #tblRewardView;
    END

    /* Result set 2 — Phân bố hình thức khen thưởng */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 2
    BEGIN
        Select
            RewardFormID as SanctionFormID,
            RewardFormName as SanctionFormName,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount
        From #tblRewardView
        Group by RewardFormID, RewardFormName
        Order by SanctionCount desc, SanctionFormName;
    END

    /* Result set 3 — Quyết định KT theo tháng (Signingdate) */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 3
    BEGIN
        Select
            Month(Signingdate) as MonthNo,
            N'T' + Cast(Month(Signingdate) as nvarchar(2)) as MonthLabel,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount,
            Count(Distinct StudentID) as StudentCount
        From #tblRewardView
        Where Signingdate is not null
        Group by Month(Signingdate)
        Order by MonthNo;
    END

    /* Result set 4 — Số quyết định KT theo khoa */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 4
    BEGIN
        Select
            ScienceID,
            ScienceName,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount,
            Count(Distinct StudentID) as StudentCount
        From #tblRewardView
        Group by ScienceID, ScienceName
        Order by SanctionCount desc, ScienceName;
    END

    /* Result set 5 — QĐ KT theo khóa / học kỳ (HK1 / HK2) */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 5
    BEGIN
        Select
            CourseID,
            CourseName,
            Sum(Case when Semester = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ActiveSanction,
            Sum(Case when Semester = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as ExpiredSanction
        From #tblRewardView
        Group by CourseID, CourseName
        Order by CourseName;
    END

    /* Result set 6 — Phân bố lý do khen thưởng */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 6
    BEGIN
        Select
            ReasonName as ViolationTypeID,
            ReasonName as ViolationTypeName,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount
        From #tblRewardView
        Group by ReasonName
        Order by SanctionCount desc, ViolationTypeName;
    END

    /* Result set 7 — Top lớp có nhiều QĐ KT */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 7
    BEGIN
        Select
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            Count(*) as SanctionCount,
            Count(Distinct StudentID) as StudentCount
        From #tblRewardView
        Group by ClassID, ClassName
        Order by SanctionCount desc, ClassName;
    END
END
GO

/*
    Ví dụ test:
    Exec dbo.DASH_StudentReward_GetData @YearID = 2025, @Semester = 1, @ResultSet = 1;
*/

content.text:
Đã bổ sung lọc **Từ ngày – Đến ngày** và chuẩn hóa chọn lớp cho dashboard Khen thưởng / Kỷ luật.

### Từ ngày – Đến ngày
- SQL lọc theo `SIM_Sanction.Signingdate` / `SIM_Reward.Signingdate`
- Mặc định tháng hiện tại (giống Ethic/Graduation)
- API truyền `@FromDate`, `@ToDate`; UI dùng `scsDashFromDate` / `scsDashToDate`

### List lớp
Trước đó chưa chuẩn (đọc `.value` của multi-select, refresh lớp như `<select>` thường). Đã chỉnh theo **ClassSize**:
- `getSelectValue` đọc checkbox `scs-ms-wrap`
- Cascade lớp qua `DASH_StudentClassSize_GetFilter` (`ClassType = 0`)
- SQL data thêm `SIM_Class.ClassType = 0`

### File đã sửa
- `sql/DASH_StudentSanction_GetData.sql`
- `sql/DASH_StudentReward_GetData.sql`
- `StudentSanctionDashboardApi.ashx.cs`
- `StudentSanctionDashboard.ascx`
- `student-sanction-dashboard.init.js`

Cần **chạy lại 2 script SQL** trên DB trước khi test.
